items.title: DGDA issues updated GMP inspection circular for local manufacturers
items.summary: The Directorate General of Drug Administration published a revised GMP inspection checklist covering sterile and non-sterile plants. Marketing authorisation holders must close CAPAs within 90 days.

items.title: PPI category remains the most prescribed GI class in urban chambers
items.summary: Medex catalogue traffic and field audits show omeprazole / esomeprazole brands dominating gastroenterology prescriptions. Square, Incepta and Healthcare lead SoV.

items.title: Price notification: essential medicines list ceiling prices reaffirmed
items.summary: DGDA reminded manufacturers not to exceed notified MRP on the national essential medicines list. Field force should flag any trade-price drift in rural pharmacies.

items.title: SGLT2 inhibitors gain share among urban endocrinologists ahead of World Diabetes Day
items.summary: Cardiologists and endocrinologists in Dhaka and Chattogram are adding SGLT2s earlier in T2DM algorithms. Plan WDD (14 Nov) camps now.

items.title: New pack images added for 400+ inhaler and insulin SKUs
items.summary: Medex.com.bd refreshed packaging photography used by MedLenX vision matching. Expect higher pack-image hit rates on respiratory and endocrine lines.

items.title: Pharmacovigilance: ADR reporting deadline reminder for Q3
items.summary: MAHs must submit quarterly ADR summaries. MPOs should collect chamber-level adverse-event notes on high-alert brands.

items.title: Chattogram Metro antibiotic SoV tightens between Square, Incepta and Beximco
items.summary: Azithromycin and cefixime remain crowded. Differentiation now depends on doctor-level conversion, not just coverage.

items.title: National dengue circular: hospital preparedness for late-monsoon surge
items.summary: DGHS asked private chambers to refer warning-sign dengue promptly. NS1 kits, ORS and antipyretic (paracetamol-only) messaging for field force.
